scripts.build:ios: pnpm ios:generate && xcodebuild -quiet -project apps/ios-learner/CadenceLearner.xcodeproj -scheme CadenceLearner -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath /tmp/CadenceLearnerDerivedData build
scripts.lint:swift: swift format lint --recursive apps/ios-learner/Sources apps/ios-learner/Tests apps/ios-learner/UITests packages/contracts/swift/Tests
scripts.test: pnpm test:js && pnpm test:swift-contracts && pnpm test:ios
scripts.test:ios: pnpm ios:generate && xcodebuild -quiet -project apps/ios-learner/CadenceLearner.xcodeproj -scheme CadenceLearner -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath /tmp/CadenceLearnerDerivedData test
